narration.text: An organic granola maker's annual update assembled: three plan changes, two suppliers no longer certified and three import certificates reported, while an old paper certificate, an exempt distributor, a lapsed grower of a non-organic mix, a change already accepted or never made, and imports that mismatch or need none are left alone. This is a chore for the owner of a small organic granola company in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, with one warehouse, a certifier's update due next month and a supplier folder full of paper certificates. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 600 dollars of the 600 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 141 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
